sources.name: GCN Circulars
sources.result: All 57 subjects in the chronological index were screened. Direct bodies or complete event groups were read for every selected event, the IceCube follow-up, the reclassification and the correction. Repetitive optical follow-ups were consolidated by event.

sources.name: Astronomer’s Telegram
sources.result: Read all three new telegram bodies. ATel 18154 selected; routine optical classifications in 18155 and a solar active-region report in 18156 excluded from this astroparticle-alert section.

sources.name: IceCube
sources.result: IceCube-261113A and its Fermi-LAT follow-up read directly. Modern Kafka stream not independently enumerated.

sources.name: GraceDB and LVK
sources.result: Accessible GraceDB latest page remained a stale 2025 snapshot and cannot verify the current window. No LVK circular occurred in GCN 46244–46300. Modern igwn.gwalert/Kafka stream was not enumerated.

sources.name: Fermi, SVOM and Einstein Probe
sources.result: All in-range GCN alert and follow-up bodies used in the selected stories were read. Mission frontends did not provide a separately complete notice ledger.

sources.name: KM3NeT
sources.result: No complete public live-alert ledger available; targeted official and GCN searches exposed no qualifying in-window report. This is an access gap, not verified quiet.

sources.name: Ground arrays and cosmic-ray facilities
sources.result: GCN/ATel screening and targeted official-source searches exposed no additional qualifying high-energy or cosmic-ray alert. FRAM-Auger optical follow-up of EP261115a is included with that event.

corrections_and_retractions: GCN 46295 corrects the trigger identifier in GCN 46243 and confirms the G 6-43 stellar-flare interpretation.
GRB 261113B was initially classified onboard as distant particles; ground analysis and Insight-HXMT support reclassification as a GRB.
No separate retraction was found in GCN 46244–46300 or ATel 18154–18156.
limitations: Modern Kafka streams were not independently enumerated.
GraceDB's accessible latest page does not establish current-window coverage.
No complete KM3NeT live-alert ledger was available.
Mission frontends did not supply complete independent ledgers; the complete GCN chronological index is the principal cross-mission record.
No claim of universal messenger quiet is made.
